title: A Moveable Feast
description: A memoir by Ernest Hemingway about his experiences as a young writer in Paris during the 1920s.

title: A Farewell to Arms
description: A novel about an American ambulance officer serving in the Italian army during World War I and his love affair with a British nurse.

title: The Bell Jar
description: A semi-autobiographical novel following Esther Greenwood as she struggles with identity, expectations, and mental health.

title: Butter
description: A literary thriller about a journalist investigating a woman accused of murdering men through her cooking.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
description: A classic novel exploring racial injustice, morality, and childhood in the American South.

title: Dune
description: A science fiction epic about Paul Atreides, whose family becomes involved in a struggle for control of the desert planet Arrakis.

title: Dune Messiah
description: The second novel in the Dune series, following Paul Atreides as emperor and exploring the consequences of his rise to power.

title: Wuthering Heights
description: A Gothic novel about the passionate and destructive relationship between Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw.

title: A Psalm for the Wild-Built
description: The first Monk and Robot novella, following a tea monk who meets a robot searching for the meaning of human needs.

title: A Prayer for the Crown-Shy
description: The second Monk and Robot novella, continuing the journey of Sibling Dex and the robot Mosscap.

title: The Courage to Be Disliked
description: A philosophical dialogue exploring Adlerian psychology, personal freedom, happiness, and the courage to live authentically.

title: Над Чорним морем
description: Роман Івана Нечуя-Левицького про українську інтелігенцію, суспільні ідеали, кохання та життя в Одесі.

title: Танець недоумка
description: Науково-фантастичний роман про космічного біолога Гіля, який вирушає в експедицію на загадкову планету Іш-Чель.

title: Swann's Way
description: The first volume of In Search of Lost Time, exploring memory, childhood, love, and society in France.

title: Time Shelter
description: A novel about a mysterious clinic that recreates past decades for patients suffering from Alzheimer's disease, raising questions about memory and nostalgia.

title: When Nietzsche Wept
description: A philosophical novel imagining an encounter between philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche and physician Josef Breuer in nineteenth-century Vienna.
